bio: Reua Thai has a rather rough-hewn feel, with wooden ornaments adding to the unique character of the space. Pattama Simons is an aficionado of authentic Thai cuisine but adds a touch of finesse. She often works with produce from her own garden or local suppliers and takes the time to create depth in her cooking. For example, she infuses beef stock with cinnamon, lemongrass, peanut and coriander to achieve a vibrant and subtly spicy flavour profile. This broth serves as a rich foundation to elevate chopped beef, rice noodles and daikon. With a choice of options for each course, the set menu is recommended to fully appreciate this aromatic cuisine....
